title: Inside McDonald’s push to have AI price your Big Mac

reading.body:
This incident is a documentation failure rather than a deployment failure. The record is built from a PDF that contains only unreadable code, so the substance of the declaration by Cynthia S. Arato cannot be recovered from the source. What the reader has is a title and a set of outlet references, not a verified account of what a system did.

The reporting that can be identified concerns a judge's warning about AI and lawyer training, and separately a push to have AI price a McDonald's product. Neither is described in the available text. Whether any AI system was deployed, and in what role, is not established here.

Catching this kind of gap would have required a readable copy of the underlying document at the point of ingestion. Without it, no failure mode can be named, because the facts do not show one. The warning attributed to a judge is a statement of concern, not a finding, and the pricing item is a report, not proof of what was built or used.
